rules: one data row per ledger event, Event_ID exactly as in operational_risk_events.csv
Loss_Event_Category is one of EL1, EL2, EL3, EL4, EL5, EL6, EL7
Business_Line is one of BL1, BL2, BL3, BL4, BL5, BL6, BL7, BL8
Loss_Amount_CNY is the exact integer amount from the ledger

key_types.gross_income_years: object mapping each four-digit year as a string to a number
key_types.positive_gi_sum_cny: number, sum of the strictly positive years

execution_log.requirement: non-empty; briefly state the classification method and the BIA capital steps
